results.title: Every entry traces to a person, a day and a job
results.expected: The contact list and the allocations are read before any anomaly is raised. Every line on the sheet names a person, a date and an allocated job. The unallocated entry is an anomaly of kind not_allocated and is not a line.

stimulus.description: Eight entries across three people, one of them on a job the person was never allocated, with the roster and the allocations in the system.

results.title: Daily and weekly totals are computed from entries, never typed
results.expected: Every published total lists the entry ids it derives from and its hours equal the sum of those entries' hours after breaks. A total with no entry ids, or with hours that do not add up, fails.

stimulus.description: A period of clean entries for two people, with a daily and a weekly total expected for each.

results.title: An anomaly is one of a closed list of kinds, and it has an owner
results.expected: The overlap, the over-hours day and the unallocated job are each raised as an anomaly with a kind from the list and an owner's name. No anomaly carries a kind outside the list or an empty owner.
results.actual: S1:overlap->Sam Hart, S2:overlap->Sam Hart, S4:over_hours->Sam Hart, S6:not_allocated->Operations manager

stimulus.description: The eight seeded entries, which include one overlapping pair, one twelve-hour day and one unallocated job.

results.title: Any penalty, overtime or allowance applied cites the rule, its edition and its effective date
results.expected: The rule store is read before any card is written. Both entries carry a card with a rule id the store holds, an edition and an effective date. A line that applies a rule and has no card fails.

stimulus.description: One entry over eight hours on a weekday and one entry on a Saturday, with two rule editions in the store.

results.title: A retired rule edition cannot apply to the next period
results.expected: Cards in the first period cite the first edition. Cards in the later period cite the second edition only. A card in the later period citing the retired edition fails.

stimulus.description: A period run under the first edition, then the first edition retired and a later period run with the second edition in force.

results.title: An entry the dated rule does not plainly cover is parked for a person
results.expected: The entry is an anomaly of kind rule_unclear with an owner, carries no card, and is not a line on the sheet. A card written for it, from any edition, fails.
results.actual: D1 anomalies: rule_unclear->Award owner; D1 cards 0

stimulus.description: One entry flagged as a disputed break, which no rule edition in the store plainly covers.

results.title: An anomaly leaves the queue only with a person's name and a reason
results.expected: Every anomaly is resolved with the name and reason the person gave, with the decision attached as evidence. An anomaly cleared with no person, or cleared before any person decided, fails.
results.actual: A1:overlap decided Sam Hart resolved Sam Hart/approved ev 1; A2:overlap decided Sam Hart resolved Sam Hart/corrected ev 1; A3:over_hours decided Sam Hart resolved Sam Hart/approved ev 1; A4:not_allocated decided Operations manager resolved Operations manager/rejected ev 1

stimulus.description: The seeded anomalies raised on a first run, then a named person decides each one in the queue, then a second run.
